ref_text: Oh, darling, you really thought you could hide from me? How sweet. I've watched you for a very long time. Every little lie. Every little secret. And now, you're mine.

lines.text: One little rhyme, darling. That's all it took.
Rain, rain, go away... so I sent the whole sky away.
Too dark? Then let there be light.
Too bright? Fine. Shrink the night.
Your turn. Rhyme the next spell... if you dare.
